All direct table/auth prerequisites in canonical foundation are present before 0047, including role_bindings, webshop_instances, admin_audit_log.
New 0047 does not grant anon/authenticated public table access and preserves service_role execution through canonical SQL.
New baseline manifest explicitly marks freshInstallProofRequired true and no unsupported completion assertion.
Negative regression rejects SQL provenance drift or missing prerequisite table, checks 0047 ordering and baseline guard.
No staging/production writes and no release DONE until next migrations and actual empty-target Fresh Install + role proof.
invariants: Canonical SQL source is the sole authority; customer baseline exact-match copy only.
Team Chat remains separate Pro capability and Alap support/email remain available.
New source migration never broadens authenticated Data API access without RLS.
No production/staging schema or data changes.
Main migration lineage and earlier 0001-0046 baseline are immutable.

specialistReviews.finding: Copying SQL without real PostgreSQL role/GRANT behavior proof could claim a false security success.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep source-only scope and explicitly block release until actual empty-target and role tests.

specialistReviews.finding: Main foundation needs baseline role_bindings, webshop_instances and admin_audit_log.
specialistReviews.resolution: Preflight source references, exact hash and strictly append after 0046.

specialistReviews.finding: Schema high-risk cannot mix other nonneutral subsystems.
specialistReviews.resolution: Only baseline SQL, manifest and evidence-neutral tests, require release risk 5/5 and later separate 0048+ units.

specialistReviews.finding: Staging real catalog has old participant rules, Fresh Install inactive.
specialistReviews.resolution: Source work only; no migrations on real projects.

challenge.scenario: A fresh customer database has not yet created role_bindings before the Team Permissions foundation migration is replayed.
challenge.finding: The foreign key from store_permission_overrides to role_bindings cannot be resolved and SQL replay aborts in the middle of setup.
challenge.resolution: Require prerequisite checks against the immutable customer baseline before generating 0047, and preserve an empty-target verification blocker.

challenge.scenario: A customer instance table has not received its expected organization identity before the composite permission-reference migration executes.
challenge.finding: The composite foreign key will reference incompatible identity columns and a later authorization decision may become cross-tenant or invalid.
challenge.resolution: Verify webshop_instances identity columns and composite uniqueness in baseline, and reject an incompatible dependency rather than weakening the foreign key.

challenge.scenario: Existing public table defaults could accidentally grant broad Data API access when the new permission tables are created.
challenge.finding: The browser role might read policy or delegation rows if the source grant and RLS statements are omitted during copying.
challenge.resolution: Copy the canonical RLS and explicit revokes verbatim, then test all affected tables and require a real role-level PostgreSQL rehearsal.

challenge.scenario: The service_role API runs canonical evaluate_store_capability_v1 after applying the permission tables.
challenge.finding: Removing an original service_role execute grant will break legitimate secure staff authorization even if the source SQL migration otherwise parses.
challenge.resolution: Preserve source function grants and SECURITY DEFINER boundaries exactly, and compare byte-for-byte source content before accepting baseline parity.

challenge.scenario: A generated 0047 SQL file silently changes a condition in the role delegation validator.
challenge.finding: A textual search for function names passes while access-control semantics drift from canonical existing production migration authority.
challenge.resolution: Require cryptographic hash equality for the complete original migration body, with no local reimplementation of permission semantics.

challenge.scenario: The manifest continues to say the earlier source snapshot had completed its Fresh Install proof after adding an unverified 0047.
challenge.finding: A CI or planning gate might equate a READY manifest with the actual Office schema having been installed and role-tested.
challenge.resolution: Mark the newly added baseline as requiring actual Fresh Install proof while explicitly recording that the overall Office closure is still blocked.

challenge.scenario: The latest U10A1 Pro-only Office SQL is deployed to production ahead of all its required prerequisite helpers.
challenge.finding: RPC and read policy functions fail when invoked, and security authorizations no longer match the running schema.
challenge.resolution: Keep the U10A1 release blocked until all ordered F1 and subsequent Office-related migrations pass a verified target-state compatibility rehearsal.

challenge.scenario: An engineer tries to fix a staging policy directly even though its migration ledger lacks source predecessors.
challenge.finding: Blind cherry-picking bypasses the required order and may damage an occupied database or create a false release completion claim.
challenge.resolution: Use a source-only customer-baseline migration branch, preserve staging unchanged, and require separate read-only lineage and approved deployment verification.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The 47-migration customer baseline 0001-0046 lacks the canonical 20260907203000 Team Permissions foundation objects and evaluate_store_capability_v1 needed by later Digital Office privacy/Team Chat source SQL. Directly copying the final Pro-only Office SQL into 0047 fails on missing objects; fresh installs need a strictly ordered, provenance-preserved first foundation release, without mutating existing tenants.
observableOutcomes: New append-only customer-baseline 0047 contains the exact canonical Team Permissions foundation SQL and matches SHA256 body provenance verified against 20260907203000 main source.
Source baseline includes required customer-instance roles, role_bindings and audit prerequisites before the new foundation; source checks explicitly BLOCK missing predecessors.
The customer-baseline validator verifies 48 ordered migrations after adding 0047; no claim of replay success or Office completeness is made.
Existing Alap customer support / transactional mail and Team Chat independent features are not altered by this foundational source-only change.
SQL syntax-sensitive and known-failure tests pass, projected release risk is 5/5, existing Fresh Install remains NOT PROVEN for this new migration.
